description: NaSiCPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.56 Å. Si is bonded to six O atoms to form SiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-1.84 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.22-1.35 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent SiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-40°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.55 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Si, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Si, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Si and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Si, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Si and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Si and one P atom.
